 20// We are going to divide capability atoms into a few categories.
 21//
 22enum class CapabilityNameFlavor : int32_t
 23{
 24    // A concrete capability atom is something that a target
 25    // can directly support, where the presence of the feature
 26    // directly provides functionality. A specific OpenGL
 27    // or Vulkan extension would be an example of a concrete
 28    // capability.
 29    //
 30    Concrete,
 31
 32    // An abstract capability represents a class of feature
 33    // where multiple distinct implementations might be possible.
 34    // 'raytracing' may be allowed with a 'raygen' "stage", but
 35    // not a 'vertex' "stage"
 36    // For more information (and a clearer description of the rules),
 37    // read `slang-capabilities.capdef`
 38    Abstract,
 39
 40    // An alias capability atom is one that is exactly equivalent
 41    // to the things it inherits from.
 42    //
 43    // For example, a `ps_5_1` capability would just be an
 44    // alias for the combination of the `fragment` capability
 45    // and the `sm_5_1` capability.
 46    //
 47    Alias,
 48};

 1106static uint32_t _calcAtomListDifferenceScore(
 1107    List<CapabilityAtom> const& thisList,
 1108    List<CapabilityAtom> const& thatList)
 01109{
 01110    uint32_t score = 0;
 1111
 1112    // Our approach here will be to scan through `this` and `that`
 1113    // to identify atoms that are in `this` but not `that` (that is,
 1114    // the atoms that would be present in the set difference `this - that`)
 1115    // and then compute the maximum rank/score of those atoms.
 1116
 01117    Index thisCount = thisList.getCount();
 01118    Index thatCount = thatList.getCount();
 01119    Index thisIndex = 0;
 01120    Index thatIndex = 0;
 1121    for (;;)
 1122    {
 01123        if (thisIndex == thisCount)
 1124            break;
 01125        if (thatIndex == thatCount)
 1126            break;
 1127

 01129        auto thatAtom = thatList[thatIndex];

 01131        if (thisAtom == thatAtom)
 1132        {
 01133            thisIndex++;
 1134            thatIndex++;
 1135            continue;
 1136        }
 1137
 01138        if (thisAtom < thatAtom)
 1139        {
 1140            // `thisAtom` is not present in `that`, so it
 1141            // should contribute to our ranking of the difference.
 1142            //
 01143            auto thisAtomInfo = _getInfo(thisAtom);
 1144            auto thisAtomRank = thisAtomInfo.rank;
 1145
 1146            if (thisAtomRank > score)
 1147            {
 1148                score = thisAtomRank;
 1149            }
 1150
 01151            thisIndex++;
 01152        }
 1153        else
 1154        {
 1155            SLANG_ASSERT(thisAtom > thatAtom);
 1156            thatIndex++;
 1157        }
 1158    }
 01159    return score;

 1870/// Generic template function for concurrent iteration over two sorted collections of the same type
 1871/// Calls callback for all elements, passing nullptr for gaps
 1872template<typename Collection, typename ElementType, typename KeyType, typename MatchCallback>
 1873void concurrentIterate(
 1874    const Collection& left,
 1875    const Collection& right,
 1876    Index (Collection::*countGetter)() const,
 1877    ElementType (Collection::*elementGetter)(Index) const,
 1878    KeyType (std::remove_pointer_t<ElementType>::*keyGetter)() const,
 1879    MatchCallback callback)

 01881    Index leftIndex = 0;
 01882    Index rightIndex = 0;
 01883    Index leftSize = (left.*countGetter)();
 01884    Index rightSize = (right.*countGetter)();
 1885
 1886    // Process elements while both collections have remaining items
 01887    while (leftIndex < leftSize && rightIndex < rightSize)
 1888    {
 01889        auto leftElement = (left.*elementGetter)(leftIndex);
 01890        auto rightElement = (right.*elementGetter)(rightIndex);
 01891        auto leftKey = (leftElement->*keyGetter)();
 01892        auto rightKey = (rightElement->*keyGetter)();
 1893
 01894        if (leftKey < rightKey)
 1895        {
 1896            // Left has element that right doesn't
 01897            if (callback(leftElement, nullptr))
 1898                return;

 01900        }
 01901        else if (leftKey > rightKey)
 1902        {
 1903            // Right has element that left doesn't
 01904            if (callback(nullptr, rightElement))
 1905                return;
 1906            rightIndex++;
 01907        }
 1908        else
 1909        {
 1910            // Found matching elements
 01911            if (callback(leftElement, rightElement))
 1912                return;
 01913            leftIndex++;
 1914            rightIndex++;
 1915        }
 1916    }
 1917
 1918    // Process remaining elements from left collection (if any)
 01919    while (leftIndex < leftSize)
 1920    {
 01921        auto leftElement = (left.*elementGetter)(leftIndex);
 01922        if (callback(leftElement, nullptr))
 1923            return;
 01924        leftIndex++;
 1925    }
 1926
 1927    // Process remaining elements from right collection (if any)
 01928    while (rightIndex < rightSize)
 1929    {
 01930        auto rightElement = (right.*elementGetter)(rightIndex);
 01931        if (callback(nullptr, rightElement))
 1932            return;
 01933        rightIndex++;
 1934    }
 01935}

 2074CapabilitySet::ImpliesReturnFlags CapabilitySetVal::_implies(
 2075    CapabilitySetVal const* otherSet,
 2076    CapabilitySet::ImpliesFlags flags) const
 02077{
 2078    SLANG_PROFILE_CAPABILITY_SETS;
 2079    // By default (`ImpliesFlags::None`): x implies (c | d) only if (x implies c) and (x implies d).
 2080
 02081    bool onlyRequireSingleImply =
 2082        ((int)flags & (int)CapabilitySet::ImpliesFlags::OnlyRequireASingleValidImply);

 2084        ((int)flags & (int)CapabilitySet::ImpliesFlags::CannotHaveMoreTargetAndStageSets);

 2086        ((int)flags & (int)CapabilitySet::ImpliesFlags::CanHaveSubsetOfTargetAndStageSets);

 2089
 02090    if (!otherSet || otherSet->isEmpty())
 02091        return CapabilitySet::ImpliesReturnFlags::Implied;
 2092
 2093    // If empty, and the other is not empty, it does not matter what flags are used,
 2094    // `this` is considered to "not imply" another set. This is important since
 2095    // `T.join(U)` causes `T == U`.
 02096    if (this->isEmpty())

 2100        this->getTargetSetCount() > otherSet->getTargetSetCount())
 2101    {
 02102        return CapabilitySet::ImpliesReturnFlags::NotImplied;
 2103    }
 2104
 2105    // Use concurrent iteration to process all target pairs
 2106    bool impliesAll = true;
 02107    concurrentIterate(
 2108        *this,
 2109        *otherSet,
 02110        [&](CapabilityTargetSetVal* thisTarget, CapabilityTargetSetVal* otherTarget) -> bool
 02111        {
 02112            if (!otherTarget)
 2113            {
 2114                // Other doesn't have this target - that's fine for implies
 2115                return false; // Continue
 2116            }
 2117
 02118            if (!thisTarget)
 2119            {
 2120                // 'this' lacks a target 'other' has
 02121                if (onlyRequireSingleImply || canHaveSubsetOfTargetAndStageSets)
 2122                {
 2123                    return false; // Continue
 2124                }
 02125                impliesAll = false;
 02126                return true; // Early exit
 2127            }
 2128
 02129            if (cannotHaveMoreTargetAndStageSets &&
 2130                thisTarget->getStageSetCount() > otherTarget->getStageSetCount())
 2131            {
 02132                impliesAll = false;
 02133                return true; // Early exit
 2134            }
 2135
 2136            // Process all stage pairs for this target
 02137            concurrentIterate(
 2138                *thisTarget,
 2139                *otherTarget,
 2140                [&](CapabilityStageSetVal* thisStage, CapabilityStageSetVal* otherStage) -> bool
 02141                {
 02142                    if (!otherStage)
 2143                    {
 2144                        // Other doesn't have this stage - that's fine for implies
 2145                        return false; // Continue
 2146                    }
 2147
 02148                    if (!thisStage)
 2149                    {
 2150                        // 'this' lacks a stage 'other' has
 02151                        if (onlyRequireSingleImply || canHaveSubsetOfTargetAndStageSets)
 2152                        {
 2153                            return false; // Continue
 2154                        }
 02155                        impliesAll = false;
 02156                        return true; // Early exit
 2157                    }
 2158
 2159                    // Check if all stage sets that are in 'other' are contained by 'this'
 02160                    auto thisAtomSet = thisStage->getAtomSet();
 02161                    auto otherAtomSet = otherStage->getAtomSet();
 2162
 02163                    if (thisAtomSet && otherAtomSet)
 2164                    {

 02166                        auto otherUIntSet = otherAtomSet->toUIntSet();
 02167                        bool contained = thisUIntSet.contains(otherUIntSet);
 2168
 02169                        if (!onlyRequireSingleImply && !contained)
 2170                        {
 02171                            impliesAll = false;
 2172                            return true; // Early exit
 2173                        }
 02174                        else if (onlyRequireSingleImply && contained)
 2175                        {
 02176                            flagsCollected |= (int)CapabilitySet::ImpliesReturnFlags::Implied;
 02177                            return true; // Early exit - found one match
 2178                        }
 02179                    }
 2180
 02181                    return false; // Continue
 02182                });
 2183
 02184            return !impliesAll; // Early exit if we failed
 02185        });
 2186
 02187    if (!onlyRequireSingleImply && impliesAll)
 02188        flagsCollected |= (int)CapabilitySet::ImpliesReturnFlags::Implied;
 2189
 2190    return (CapabilitySet::ImpliesReturnFlags)flagsCollected;
 02191}
